description:
**Job Title:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Location:** Coimbatore/Bangalore

**About AppViewX:**

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

**Our Values**

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.

* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.

* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.

* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.

* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a full-cycle Technical Recruiter to drive end-to-end recruitment across technical roles, from sourcing and talent engagement to offer closure and onboarding. You will own the entire recruitment lifecycle, partnering closely with hiring managers and key stakeholders to understand their requirements for the specific requisition, develop effective sourcing strategies, build strong talent pipelines, and deliver a high-quality candidate experience.

  

This role requires strong expertise in technical hiring, proactive sourcing, stakeholder management, and recruitment analytics, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions, provide data-driven hiring insights, and drive hiring outcomes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the full recruitment cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer support, and closure.

* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles and interview plans for Product Engineering and related technical roles, including but not limited to software engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, threat research and other specialized technical disciplines as assigned.

* Source candidates proactively through various sourcing platforms, technical communities, conferences, referrals, and talent databases.

* Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and hard-to-fill technical roles.

* Conduct initial screening calls to assess background, motivation, notice period and compensation expectations.

* Manage candidate communication and experience end to end, keeping candidates informed at every stage.

* Ensure hiring practices follow company policy, Indian labor and data protection requirements, and fair hiring standards.

* Support employer branding activities, including campus outreach, community engagement and recruiting events.

* Partner with hiring managers and interview panels to drive timely feedback, decisions, and hiring outcomes.

* Ensure structured interviews, consistent candidate evaluation, and effective interview processes.

* Track and report recruitment metrics, including pipeline health, time-to-fill, conversion rates, and offer acceptance.

* Drive offer management and closure by aligning candidate expectations and proactively managing offer drop-offs.

* Maintain accurate ATS records, recruitment data, and compliance with defined processes.

* Provide talent market insights on candidate availability, compensation trends, and sourcing challenges.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a substantial share in technology or engineering hiring.

* Recent experience hiring engineers in cybersecurity, SaaS, or other technical product companies. Experience with security-specific roles such as SOC, penetration testing, GRC or application security is a strong plus.

* Proven sourcing skills: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre, and technical community sourcing.

* Ability to understand and discuss technical profiles, tech stacks, and engineering career paths with candidates and hiring managers.

* Experience managing high-volume and niche requisitions at the same time, with clear prioritization.

* Working knowledge of the Indian hiring market, notice period norms, and candidate expectations across experience levels.

* Strong stakeholder management and comfort giving direct feedback to hiring managers.

* Familiarity with an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse experience preferred) and recruiting metrics.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

  

**Why AppViewX?**

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

**About BDIL**

**Bharati Defence & Infrastructure Limited (BDIL)** is one of India's emerging defence technology and system integration organizations, delivering advanced communication, surveillance, and mission-critical solutions across Air, Land, and Marine platforms.

**BDIL** is now firmly aligned with the **Government of India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat and Make in India vision**, aspiring to play a leading role in **indigenous defence manufacturing, shipbuilding, and allied infrastructure projects**

**Job Summary**

BDIL is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter with an engineering background who can manage end-to-end hiring for technical and non-technical roles who will primarily recruit EXTC (Electronics & Telecommunication).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full recruitment cycle, from requirement gathering and sourcing to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
* Work with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and create accurate job descriptions.
* Source candidates for roles in electronics, telecommunications, embedded systems, RF, networking, VLSI, IoT, and hardware design.
* Use job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.), Boolean search, social media, referrals to build strong talent pipelines.
* Conduct initial technical and HR screening to check candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* Schedule and coordinate technical interview round with hiring manager and candidates.
* Negotiate salaries, roll out offers, and manage candidates through joining to reduce drop-offs.
* Maintain recruitment data in the trackers, and share regular hiring reports and metrics (time-to-hire, offer-to-join ratio, etc.).
* Build relationships with engineering colleges and universities for campus and fresher hiring.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication, Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline. Engineering background preferred.
* 2–4 years of experience in technical recruitment, in company and startups.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of electronics, telecom, and software/AI technologies and job roles.
* Strong sourcing skills, including Boolean search and headhunting.
* Hands-on experience with job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and ATS tools.
* Ability to handle multiple positions and meet hiring deadlines.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets for reporting.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for core electronics, telecom, semiconductor, or product companies.
* Exposure to niche tech hiring.

**Why Join Us?**

* Contribute to India's growing defence technology sector.
* Gain exposure to diverse engineering and emerging technologies.

description:
ABOUT BITSCALE

Bitscale is the GTM data layer for your CRM. Sales and growth teams use us to enrich their Salesforce and HubSpot records, run data waterfalls across 100+ sources, and catch live buying signals - research that used to take an SDR a week now runs in an afternoon.

Over 1,000 B2B GTM teams run on Bitscale, including Delhivery, DevRev, Moglix, Yellow.ai, Schneider, Scrut Automation and Testsigma. We are SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, and backed by First Cheque (India Quotient) along with angels including Kunal Shah (CRED) and Ankit Nagori (Curefoods).

Founded in 2023, based in Gurugram - and about to roughly double the team.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We are hiring 9 people over the next two quarters - 3 Account Executives, 2 Customer Success Managers, a DevRel, an Associate PM, a Business Ops Analyst, and an Engineer. Right now the founders are doing all of that recruiting themselves. It does not scale, and it is not the best use of anyone's time.

You will be our first dedicated people hire. Not a coordinator on someone else's team - the person who owns how Bitscale hires and how it runs its people function. There is nobody above you in HR, and that is the point.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

First 6 months - mostly recruiting:

- Own full-cycle hiring for 9 open roles: sourcing, screening, scheduling, coordinating interviews, and keeping candidates warm through to offer

- Build and run outbound sourcing on LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre and communities - including using Bitscale's own product to build and enrich candidate lists

- Write outreach that people actually reply to, and own our response rates as a number you are measured on

- Set up an ATS and run it properly: no candidate goes dark, every role has a live pipeline

- Partner with the founders on interview loops, scorecards and closing candidates

Month 3 onwards - building the people function:

- Own onboarding: offer letters, documentation, day-one experience

- Manage our payroll and compliance vendor (you coordinate it; you will not be doing statutory filings by hand)

- Build the basics we do not have yet - HR policies, leave and attendance, employee handbook, POSH compliance

- Own employer branding: how Bitscale shows up to candidates on LinkedIn and everywhere else

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 1-3 years in recruiting - agency, RPO or in-house. Agency background is genuinely welcome; you will find the volume here familiar and the ownership better.

- You have closed roles end to end, and you can tell us the specifics: how many you screened, where they came from, how long it took.

- Strong written English. Outreach is most of this job. If your messages read like templates, candidates will not reply.

- Comfortable with outbound sourcing, not just screening inbound applications.

- Organised enough to run 8-9 live pipelines without dropping anyone.

- You want to grow into a generalist HR role. This is not a pure recruiting seat.

NICE TO HAVE

- Hired GTM roles before - AEs, SDRs, Customer Success

- Worked at a startup under 100 people

- Any exposure to HR operations, payroll or compliance

- Handy with AI tools for sourcing and writing

WHAT YOU GET

- ESOP - you are early, and you are treated that way

- Rs 5-8 LPA fixed, depending on experience

- A clear path to owning the entire people function as we grow. The next HR hires report to you.

- Direct access to the founders. You will sit in on how a company gets built, not just how it staffs up.

- Real ownership from week one - we are not going to tell you which job board to use

HOW TO APPLY

No need to apply here,

Email sanket@bitscale.ai with your CV and this assignment solution-  
- Create and send a list of 20 candidates who are right fit for Account executive role in Bitscale with 2-3 years of experience who are currently working in Rippling India.

We reply to everyone. Process is 1 rounds over about 1 weeks.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gurugram, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Write the first outreach message you would send to an Account Executive currently working at a competitor, to get them interested in Bitscale. Around 100 words.
* When would you be able to join?
* Have you submitted the assignment given for this role in the job descriptino below?

Experience:

* recruiting: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
We are seeking a Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).

**Work you'll do**

As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**

**Shift Timings: Rotational**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.
* Experience implementing large language model guardrails, safety controls, or agent sandboxing patterns.
* Certification in DevSecOps, cloud security, Kubernetes security, AI security, or generative AI, such as Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified AI Practitioner.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. **Job Type:** Full Time  
**Work Mode:** Office / Remote (depending on business requirements)  
**Work Timings:** 12:00 PM - 9 PM IST  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years (Freshers with excellent communication skills may also be considered)

***Company Description***  
Idea Elan LLC is a product-based company that provides comprehensive software solutions for research facilities in Universities and Institutions worldwide. Please visit www.IdeaElan.com for more information.

***Role Summary***   
We are looking for a motivated Junior Recruiter to support end-to-end recruitment for our India and US hiring requirements. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in technical & non technical recruitment, including exposure to US hiring, candidate sourcing, screening and recruitment coordination.

***Key Responsibilities***   
● Handle end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions across India and the US.  
● Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals and other recruitment channels.  
● Screen resumes and conduct initial HR screening calls to assess candidate suitability, communication and interest.  
● Experience sourcing candidates for US positions and understanding US recruitment practices is essential.  
● Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and hiring priorities.  
● Schedule interviews, follow up with candidates and keep them informed throughout the recruitment process.  
● Maintain regular communication with shortlisted candidates and follow up on joining dates, offer acceptance and potential dropouts.  
● Support compensation discussions and candidate engagement in coordination with the hiring team.  
● Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment trackers and pipeline updates.  
● Ensure timely follow-ups with candidates and hiring managers to minimise delays in the recruitment process.  
● Support US recruitment activities during the designated overlap with US working hours.

***Required Skills and Qualifications***   
● 1 - 3 years of experience in recruitment, preferably technical recruitment.  
● Prior hands-on experience with US recruitment is mandatory.  
● Experience sourcing and screening candidates for US positions.  
● Understanding of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle.  
● Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals and other sourcing techniques.  
● Good verbal and written communication skills.  
● Strong follow-up, coordination and candidate management skills.  
● Ability to manage multiple positions and work independently.  
● Willingness to work from 12 PM to 9 PM IST to support India and US recruitment requirements. What We Offer  
● Opportunity to work with a global SaaS product-based company.  
● Exposure to US recruitment and international talent acquisition.  
● Opportunities to build campus hiring partnerships and develop recruitment expertise.

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company.

Sports organizations generate enormous volumes of fan, ticketing, sponsorship, and commercial data, but it only creates value when it is trusted, connected, and ready to use. **Key Responsibilities**

**Build Data Pipelines**

* Build and maintain batch data pipelines using SQL, Python, and PySpark to ingest, transform, and serve fan, sponsorship, ticketing, CRM, and commercial datasets

* Develop components of reusable ETL/ELT frameworks under the guidance of senior engineers, following established design patterns and coding standards

* Write, test, and tune SQL and Python code for correctness and performance, with unit tests and clear documentation

**Make Data Trustworthy**

* Implement data quality checks, validation routines, and lineage documentation that make data assets trustworthy for product use

* Contribute to data models and schemas that support analytics, machine learning, and agentic product features

**Ship as One Team**

* Partner with product managers and data scientists to translate defined requirements into production-ready data assets and feature pipelines

* Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of pipelines in production, working with application engineering and DevOps teams on CI/CD and observability

* Participate in Agile ceremonies and code reviews, and keep work items, estimates, and status current for USI and US stakeholders

* Help standardize data adapters and schemas across the ConvergeSPORTS product portfolio by documenting and reusing existing patterns

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with product management, data science, and application engineering, partners with US-based ConvergeSPORTS product and engineering leaders, and collaborates with DevOps and delivery teams across USI.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience building and supporting data pipelines in product, platform, or data-intensive delivery environments

* Proficiency in SQL and Python, including writing, testing, and tuning data transformation code

* Experience with at least one cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL

* Experience with Spark/PySpark or comparable distributed data processing frameworks, and with workflow orchestration

* Experience with Git/GitHub, branching, code review, and Agile product development

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders

**Preferred**

* Experience with sports, media, entertainment, sponsorship, ticketing, CRM, loyalty, or fan engagement data

* Experience with Delta Lake or lakehouse patterns, Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or dbt

* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, or GCP

* Experience preparing data for AI, recommendation, scoring, or segmentation use cases

**Core Competencies**

* Curious and quick to learn, acts on feedback from senior engineers

* Detail-oriented, treats data accuracy, testing, and documentation as part of the work

* Clear communicator who raises blockers early across USI and US teams

* Collaborative with product, data science, and engineering

**Why This Role Matters**

Every ConvergeSPORTS product decision, from fan engagement to sponsorship optimization, depends on data that teams can trust. As a Data Engineer, you will build the pipelines behind that trust and grow your craft alongside experienced engineers on products used across the sports industry.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and proactive HR & Admin Manager to oversee the company's human resources functions and administrative operations. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in end-to-end HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, office administration, and team management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth HR and administrative operations, maintaining compliance with applicable labour laws, developing HR processes, and supporting management in achieving organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Human Resource Management

Manage end-to-end HR operations, including employee lifecycle management from onboarding to exit.

Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.

Handle manpower planning and coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements.

Manage recruitment activities, including job postings, screening, interviewing, selection, and offer negotiation.

Ensure timely onboarding, induction, documentation, and background verification of new employees.

Maintain employee records, HR databases, attendance, leave, and personnel files.

Manage employee engagement initiatives, grievance handling, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution.

* Coordinate performance appraisal processes, employee feedback, and training

and development initiatives.

* Handle employee separation, exit interviews, full-and-final settlement

coordination, and relieving documentation.

* Support management in workforce planning, retention strategies, and

organizational development.

2. Payroll & Compensation Management

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, attendance, leave

adjustments, incentives, and deductions.

* Ensure accurate calculation and processing of salaries in coordination with the

payroll team or external consultant.

* Manage payroll-related documentation, salary revisions, and employee

compensation records.

* Coordinate preparation of salary slips, payroll reports, and other employeerelated

financial records.

* Ensure timely processing of full-and-final settlements and employee

reimbursements.

3. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and employment regulations.
* Coordinate statutory compliance relating to PF, ESIC, professional tax, labour

welfare fund, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable requirements.

* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and compliance records.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, and government authorities for

inspections, filings, and audits as required.

* Monitor changes in applicable labour regulations and ensure timely

implementation of necessary updates.

4. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, supervise, and manage the HR and administration team.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and ensure timely completion of

departmental activities.

* Guide team members on recruitment, HR operations, employee relations, and

administrative processes.

* Set team priorities, review performance, and provide coaching and feedback.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency and

accountability.

* Coordinate with senior management and other departments to address

workforce and administrative requirements.

5. Office Administration & Facility Management

* Oversee day-to-day office administration and ensure smooth functioning of

office operations.

* Manage office facilities, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and other

support services.

* Handle procurement of office supplies, stationery, equipment, and

administrative requirements.

* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, landlords, and facility management

agencies.

* Monitor administrative expenses, vendor bills, budgets, and cost-control

initiatives.

* Ensure proper maintenance of office assets, inventory, records, and company

property.

* Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, meetings, events, and other

administrative activities as required.

* Ensure workplace safety, cleanliness, and adherence to company policies.

6. Attendance, Leave & HR Documentation

* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, leave balances, and overtime

records where applicable.

* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee master data and HR documentation.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports, including headcount, attrition, recruitment

status, attendance, and leave reports.

* Maintain confidentiality and security of employee information.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of employment-related documents,

licences, and administrative records as applicable.

7. Management Reporting & Coordination

* Prepare periodic HR and administrative reports for senior management.
* Provide updates on recruitment, manpower costs, employee turnover,

absenteeism, and team performance.

* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve operational

efficiency.

* Coordinate with Finance, Operations, and other departments for smooth

business functioning.

* Support management in implementing HR initiatives, policy changes, and

organizational improvements.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good knowledge of HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, and

statutory compliance.

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Good organizational, planning, and multitasking skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, and HRMS/payroll systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee matters

professionally.

* Strong vendor management, coordination, and administrative management

skills.

Educational Qualifications

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant postgraduate qualification

preferred.

Experience Requirements

* Preferably 8-10 years of relevant experience in HR and administration.

administration.
